shared_elements: male figure in strict profile, low relief
elaborate patterned/curled beard and hair rendered as regular rows of curls
arm raised/bent forward holding an object in the hand
handled vessel or bowl carried in the hand
long belted robe with patterned or fringed edging
muscular bared forearm with detailed wrist band
figures facing consistently in one direction
justification: Both depict profile figures in shallow relief with identical conventions for tightly curled patterned beards and hair, bared muscular forearms with wristbands, belted fringed robes, and a raised hand carrying a vessel or handled container, which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. The largest difference in content is that A shows a single large composite being with a raptor head and multiple layered wings occupying the whole panel, whereas B shows a repeated frieze of ordinary human attendants in a procession.
